newsitem.title: USA: Promus files for $300 million in debt.
newsitem.headline: Promus files for $300 million in debt.

text.p: Promus Hotel Corp said Friday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to issue up to $300 million in debt securities.
The Memphis, Tenn-based hotel company said net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including, but not limited to acquisitions, capital expenditures and working capital requirements.
Proceeds will also be used to repay, redeem or repurchase outstanding indebtedness and to repurchase outstanding Promus stock, the filing said.
The company operates the Embassy Suites, Embassy Vacation Resorts, Hampton Inn, Hampton Inn Suites and Homewood Suites hotel brands.
